blocks.text: A chart can keep event listeners and drawing resources. Destroy the instance when its canvas or page part is removed.
Use a browser project with Chart.js 4 installed. Each example creates its own canvas inside a sized holder. Package imports need your project build tool and do not run in this playground.

blocks.title: Destroy an unused chart

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.
`chart.destroy()` removes the chart's internal listeners and resources before its canvas is discarded or reused.

blocks.text: Calling removeChart cleans up the instance and its container.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Destroy the old instance before reusing a canvas for another chart. Do not keep hidden unused charts running.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Identify the cleanup call before holder.remove.
